final_wiki.answer-Q-1282-A59:
Q-1282: What day of the week was 2025-09-17?

Answer: Wednesday

Calculation: Jan 1, 2025 = Wednesday (Jan 1, 2024 was Monday; 2024 leap year has 366 days, 366 mod 7 = 2, so +2 = Wednesday). Days from Jan 1 to Sep 17 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+17 = 260, so 259 days after Jan 1. 259 mod 7 = 0, so same weekday as Jan 1 = Wednesday.
